req.statement: The system shall document TaskCreate, TaskUpdate, and Task schemas in the OpenAPI spec.

doc.reasoning: R-TASK-040 requires that the OpenAPI spec (GET /openapi.json) documents TaskCreate, TaskUpdate, and Task schemas. Tests must verify: (1) positive — all three schema names appear in the spec with correct HTTP 200 response; (2) negative — the endpoint is reachable and does not return a 4xx; (3) boundary — each schema contains the exact fields defined in schemas.py (title, description, completed for TaskCreate/TaskUpdate; id, created_at, updated_at, title, description, completed for Task). Mutation-resilient assertions use exact status codes, exact schema name strings, and exact field names to catch constant/string mutations.

tests.name: test_openapi_returns_200_and_contains_all_three_schema_names
actions: Check that 'TaskCreate', 'TaskUpdate', and 'Task' keys exist under components.schemas
trace: R-TASK-040: system shall document TaskCreate, TaskUpdate, and Task schemas in the OpenAPI spec
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app

def test_openapi_returns_200_and_contains_all_three_schema_names():
    client = TestClient(app)
    r = client.get("/openapi.json")
    assert r.status_code == 200
    body = r.json()
    schemas = body["components"]["schemas"]
    assert "TaskCreate" in schemas
    assert "TaskUpdate" in schemas
    assert "Task" in schemas

test_openapi_returns_200_and_contains_all_three_schema_names()

tests.name: test_openapi_schema_count_not_missing_any_required_schema
actions: Collect all schema names from components.schemas
Assert none of the three required schemas are absent
expected: Schema names set includes TaskCreate, TaskUpdate, Task
trace: R-TASK-040: all three schemas must be present — absence of any one is a failure
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app

def test_openapi_schema_count_not_missing_any_required_schema():
    client = TestClient(app)
    r = client.get("/openapi.json")
    assert r.status_code == 200
    body = r.json()
    schema_names = set(body["components"]["schemas"].keys())
    required = {"TaskCreate", "TaskUpdate", "Task"}
    missing = required - schema_names
    assert missing == set(), f"Missing schemas: {missing}"

test_openapi_schema_count_not_missing_any_required_schema()
